claim.claim-text: 1. A supporting device (10,10',10",10‴,10ʺʺ,10‴ʺ) for furniture shelves for the reversible connection of a shelf (100) to the shoulders (200) of a piece of furniture, wherein the connection is obtained by means of a pin (11) associated with said shelf (100) and configured so as to protrude from the edge (B) of said shelf and be inserted into a corresponding receiving hole (201) formed on said shoulder (200) of said piece of furniture, the device (10,10',10",10‴, 10ʺʺ,10‴ʺ) comprising a main body (12) with which movable engagement means (15,15',15",15‴) associated with a pin (11), are slidingly associated, said device (10,10',10", 10‴,10ʺʺ,10‴ʺ) being configured for being inserted within the thickness of said shelf (100) and said movable engagement means (15,15',15',15‴) being sliding with respect to said main body (12) along a sliding direction (Y) between a first non-operating position in which said pin (11) does not protrude from said shelf (100), and a second operating position in which said pin (11) protrudes from said shelf (100) outwardly, said supporting device (10,10',10",10‴, 10ʺʺ,10‴ʺ) comprising actuation means (13,21,32) of said movable engagement means (15,15',15',15‴), and movement-transmission means (13b,15c,15b,15c",20,21b,31) suitable for transforming the movement of said actuation means (13,21,32) into the translational movement along the sliding direction (Y) of said movable engagement means (15,15',15",15‴).

2. The supporting device (10,10',10",10‴) for furniture shelves according to the previous claim, characterized in that said actuation means (13,21,32) of said movable engagement means (15,15',15",15‴) can be rotated around an axis (X) substantially orthogonal with respect to the sliding direction (Y) of said movable engagement means (15,15',15",15‴).

3. The supporting device (10ʺʺ,10‴ʺ) for furniture shelves according to claim 1, characterized in that said actuation means (32) of said movable engagement means (15‴) can be actuated along a direction (X) substantially orthogonal with respect to the sliding direction (Y) of said movable engagement means (15‴).

4. The supporting device (10,10',10",10‴,10ʺʺ,10‴ʺ) for furniture shelves according to any of the previous claims, characterized in that it further comprises retention means (15d,15d",14c,25,32,35) suitable for keeping said engagement means (15,15',15",15‴) blocked in said first non-operating position in which said pin (11) does not protrude from said shelf (100).

5. The supporting device (10,10',10",10‴,10ʺʺ,10‴ʺ) for furniture shelves according to any of the previous claims, characterized in that said movable engagement means (15,15',15",15‴) can be further moved in at least a third intermediate non-operating and non-blocked position in which said pin (11) is free to withdraw until it is completely retracted but wherein said retention means (15d,14c,25,32,35) do not keep said engagement means (15,15',15",15‴) blocked.

6. The supporting device (10,10') for furniture shelves according to the previous claim, characterized in that said movable engagement means (15,15") comprise a slide (15,15") with which said pin (11) is integrally associated, said slide comprising an outlet (15a) suitable for receiving said actuation means (13) which in turn comprise a cam (13) having a substantially hollow cylindrical central body (13a) whose central axial hole (13c) is shaped for receiving a maneuvering tool, and an elongated body having a shaped profile (13b) suitable for interacting with the internal profile (15b,15c,15c") of said outlet (15a) of said slide (15) so as to transform the rotation movement of said cam (13) around the axis (X) passing through said central shaped hole of said central body (13a) into the translational movement of said slide (15) in the direction (Y).

7. The supporting device (10,10') for furniture shelves according to the previous claim, characterized in that said main body (12) comprises a seat for receiving said slide (14a, 14b) within which said slide (15) is slidingly housed.

8. The supporting device (10,10') for furniture shelves according to the previous claim, characterized in that said main body (12) is composed of two half-shells (12a,12b) each of said half-shells (12a,12b) housing a respective portion of the receiving seat (14a,14b) of said slide (15), a receiving hole (16a,16b) being further provided on each of said half-shells (12a,12b) for receiving the central body (13a) of said cam (13), said receiving holes (16a,16b) being reciprocally aligned along the axis (X) when the device is assembled and providing access for a tool to said shaped central hole (13c) of said cam (13).

9. The supporting device (10,10') for furniture shelves according to claim 6, characterized in that said shaped central hole (13c) of said cam (13) is pass-through, so that said cam (13) can be actuated in rotation by means of a tool, accessing both the top and the bottom of the main body (12) of the device (10,10').

10. The supporting device (10,10') for furniture shelves according to one or more of the previous claims, characterized in that said sliding direction (Y) coincides with the symmetry axis of said pin (11) and of said main body (12).

11. The supporting device (10,10') for furniture shelves according to one or more of the previous claims, characterized in that said central body (13a) of said cam (13) is positioned with its own cylindrical symmetry axis, coincident with its own rotation axis (X), arranged orthogonally with respect to the sliding direction (Y) of said slide (15), said central body (13a) of said cam (13) being positioned along the symmetry axis (Y) of the main body (12) which defines the sliding direction of said slide (15).

12. The supporting device (10,10') for furniture shelves according to one or more of the previous claims, characterized in that said cam (13) is rotatable around the rotation axis (X) passing through the shaped hole (13c) of its substantially cylindrical central body (13a) between a first non-operating position in which said cam (13) is arranged with its elongated shaped body (13b) along the symmetry axis (Y) and is completely contained within said outlet (15a) formed inside said slide (15) abutting against the internal wall of said outlet (15a) so as to keep said slide (15) in a withdrawn position so that said pin (11) does not protrude from said shelf (100), and a second operating position in which said cam (13) is arranged with its own shaped elongated body (13b) arranged substantially orthogonal to said symmetry axis (Y) and is abutted against the end of its elongated body (13b) within an abutment seat (17) formed on said main body (12) so as to keep said slide (15) in an advanced position so that said pin (11) protrudes from said shelf (100).

13. The supporting device (10,10') for furniture shelves according to one or more of the previous claims, characterized in that said main body (12) of said device has a bilobed profile on a vertical transversal plane having two portions of rounded ends (12c, 12d), preferably with a circular section.

14. The supporting device (10,10') for furniture shelves according to one or more of the previous claims, characterized in that said main body (12) of said device is configured for being assembled inside said shelf (100) flush with the transverse edge (B) of said shelf (100) from which said pin (11) protrudes and is designed for facing the shoulder (200) of the furniture for connecting the shelf (100) to the shoulder (200), and in that said slide (15) of said device (10) is configured so that when it is in said first non-operating position in which said slide (15) is in a withdrawn position, said pin (11) does not protrude from the edge of the main body (12) which is flush with the edge of said shelf (100) designed for facing the shoulder (200) of the furniture.

15. The supporting device (10') for furniture shelves according to one or more of the previous claims, characterized in that it further comprises elastic means (19) interposed between an internal abutment surface of said main body (12) and said slide (15) and suitable for opposing a retraction movement of the slide (15) which causes the passage from the operating position in which said slide (15) is in an advanced position and said pin (11) extends outwardly from the shelf (100) to the non-operating position in which said slide (15) is in the withdrawn position and said pin (11) does not protrude from said shelf (100) when the device is assembled on a shelf (100).

16. The supporting device (10') for furniture shelves according to the previous claim, characterized in that said slide further comprises, at the edge of said slide (15) opposite the transverse edge (B) from which said pin extends (11), a pin (18) having a longitudinal development and developing along said symmetry axis (Y) on which said elastic means (19) are positioned.
17. The supporting device (10') for furniture shelves according to the previous claim, characterized in that said elastic means consist of a helical spring (19).

18. The supporting device (10") for furniture shelves according to any of claims 1 to 3, characterized in that said movable engagement means comprise a slide (15') with which said pin (11) is integrally associated, a rack (20) being provided on said slide (15'), and in that said actuation means (21) of said engagement means (15') comprise a pinion (21) which can be rotated around the axis (X) substantially orthogonal with respect to the sliding direction (Y) of said rack (20).

19. The supporting device (10") for furniture shelves according to the previous claim, characterized in that said slide (15') comprises an outlet (15a') within which said rack (20) is provided and suitable for receiving said actuation means (21) which in turn comprise a pinion (21) having a substantially cylindrical central body (21a) within which a shaped central hole (21c) is formed, for receiving a maneuvering tool and a toothed portion (21b) suitable for interacting with said rack (20) so as to transform the rotational movement of said pinion (21) around the axis (X) passing through said shaped central hole (21c) of said central body (21a) of the pinion (21) into the translational movement of said slide (15') in the direction (Y).

20. The supporting device (10") for furniture shelves according to any of claims 14 to 15, characterized in that said main body (12) is composed of two half-shells (12a, 12b), each of said half-shells (12a, 12b) housing a respective portion of a housing seat (14a, 14b) of said slide (15'), a receiving hole (16a, 16b) being further provided on each of said half-shells (12a, 12b), for receiving the central body (21a) of said pinion (21), said receiving holes (16a, 16b) being reciprocally aligned along the axis (X) when the device is assembled, and providing access for a tool to said shaped central hole (21c) of said pinion (21).

21. The supporting device (10") for furniture shelves according to claim 16, characterized in that said shaped central hole (21c) of said pinion (21) is pass-through, so that said pinion (21) can be actuated in rotation by means of a tool, accessing the main body (12) of the device (10) from both above and below.

22. The supporting device (10") for furniture shelves according to one or more of claims 16 to 19, characterized in that it further comprises elastic means (19) interposed between an internal abutment surface of said main body (12) and said slide (15') and suitable for opposing a retraction movement of the slide (15') which causes the passage from the operating position in which said slide (15') is in an advanced position and said pin (11) extends outwardly from the shelf (100), to the non-operating position in which said slide (15') is in the withdrawn position and said pin (11) does not protrude from said shelf (100) when the device is assembled on a shelf (100).
23. The supporting device (10") for furniture shelves according to the previous claim, characterized in that said elastic means comprise a helical spring (19).

24. The supporting device (10") for furniture shelves according to the previous claim, characterized in that said slide (15') comprises a tubular receiving seat (18') suitable for receiving said elastic means (19).

25. The supporting device (10") for furniture shelves according to one or more of claims 16 to 19, characterized in that said retention means comprise one or more retaining grooves (25) formed on said slide (15') and configured for receiving corresponding elastically deformable engagement teeth (14c) formed inside the main body (12) so as to allow the snap-engagement of said engagement teeth (14c) within said retaining grooves (25).

26. The supporting device (10‴) for furniture shelves according to any of claims 1, 2 or 3, characterized in that said movable engagement means comprise a slide (15‴) in turn comprising a tilted plane (31) which is tilted with respect to the horizontal direction so that the interaction with actuation means (32) moving in the direction (X) substantially orthogonal with respect to the sliding direction (Y) of said slide (15‴) causes the withdrawal of said slide (15‴) and therefore of said pin (11) against the action of a spring (19) suitable for keeping said slide (15‴) in an advanced position.

27. The supporting device (10‴) for furniture shelves according to the previous claim, when this depends on claim 2, characterized in that said actuation means (32) movable along the direction (X) substantially orthogonal with respect to the sliding direction (Y) of said slide (15‴), comprise a threaded grub screw (32) that can be screwed by means of a tool (U) into a threaded seat (33) which extends along said orthogonal direction (X) and configured for abutting against said tilted plane (31) of said slide (15''').

28. The supporting device (10ʺʺ,10‴ʺ) for furniture shelves according to claim 26 when this depends on claim 3, characterized in that said actuation means (32) movable along the direction (X) substantially orthogonal with respect to the sliding direction (Y) of said slide (15‴) comprise a plug (32) which can be inserted into a hole (12') specifically provided on said main body (12) and suitable for being arranged in correspondence with said hole (F) formed in the shelf when the device is assembled, said plug (32) being suitable for exerting a thrust on the tilted plane (31) of said slide (15‴) so that the thrust along the direction (X) substantially orthogonal to the sliding direction (Y) of the slide (15‴) causes the slide to withdraw against the action of a spring (19) with a consequent withdrawal of the pin (11).

29. The supporting device (10ʺʺ) for furniture shelves according to the previous claim, characterized in that it comprises a second hole (12') on said main body (12) in axis with said first hole (12) for the insertion of said plug (32).

30. The supporting device (10‴ʺ) for furniture shelves according to claim 28, characterized in that it further comprises retention means (34) for the slide (15‴) suitable for keeping said slide (15‴) in a withdrawn position against the action exerted by the spring (19) even when said plug (32) is removed.

31. The supporting device (10‴ʺ) for furniture shelves according to the previous claim, characterized in that said retention means (34) comprise a rod (35) equipped at one end with a retaining tooth (36) and pivoted on a hinge (37) so as to be able to pivot around said hinge (37), said slide (15‴) comprising a receiving seat (38) for said retaining tooth (36).

32. The supporting device (10‴ʺ) for furniture shelves according to the previous claim, characterized in that it further comprises, below the end of said rod (35) from which said retaining tooth (36) develops, a helical spring (40) or similar means suitable for exerting a thrust on the end of said rod (35) suitable for keeping said retaining tooth (36) stably engaged within said receiving seat (38), the main body (12) of said device further comprising a hole (39) positioned at the end of said rod (35) opposite to the end provided with said retaining tooth (36) and suitable for allowing the insertion of an unblocking tool (50) for moving the rod (35) rotating around the hinge (37) against the action of the spring (40) causing the retaining tooth (36) to exit from the receiving seat (38) and the consequent movement of the slide (15‴) under the pressure of the helical spring (19).

33. The supporting device (10,10',10",10‴,10ʺʺ,10‴ʺ) for furniture shelves according to any of the previous claims, configured so as to require, with the device assembled in a shelf (100), the creation of a hole (F) for the access of a maneuvering tool (U) having a diameter less than 3 mm.
